newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola FEMSA lowered.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said on Monday it lowered its intermediate-term rating on the shares of Coca-Cola FEMSA to an accumulate from a buy, but maintained its long-term buy rating on the stock.
-- Analyst Enrique Figueroa said his outlook on the stock remained positive and the downgrade was based on price appreciation.
-- "The shares have rised over 42 percent over the past six weeks," he said.
-- Figueroa said he raised his 12-month price target to $55 per share, but this did not offer the 25 percent upside needed to justify an intermediate-term buy rating.
